title: DP-IVON-Gradsq: Differentially Private Squared-Gradient Improved Variational Online Newton
abstract: arXiv:2607.23649v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Differential privacy provides formal privacy guarantees for training neural networks on sensitive data, while Bayesian deep learning offers a principled framework for uncertainty-aware prediction. Combining these two objectives remains challenging, as privacy noise can interact with the stochasticity introduced by Bayesian posterior sampling. In this work, we investigate differentially private variational Bayesian learning through the Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON) optimizer. We introduce DP-IVON-Gradsq, a private variant of IVON. The proposed method constructs its curvature estimate from the privatized gradient using a noise-corrected squared-gradient estimator, reducing the direct interaction between posterior-sampling noise and privacy noise while preserving the Adam-like computational efficiency of IVON. translated_title: DP-IVON-Gradsq：差分隐私平方梯度改进变分在线牛顿法
translated_abstract: 差分隐私为在敏感数据上训练神经网络提供了正式的隐私保证，而贝叶斯深度学习则为不确定性感知的预测提供了一个有原则的框架。将这两个目标结合起来仍然具有挑战性，因为隐私噪声可能会与贝叶斯后验采样所引入的随机性相互作用。在这项工作中，我们通过改进变分在线牛顿法（IVON）优化器来研究差分隐私下的变分贝叶斯学习。我们提出了DP-IVON-Gradsq，这是IVON的一个隐私保护变体。所提出的方法使用噪声校正的平方梯度估计器，从私有化后的梯度构建曲率估计，在保持IVON类Adam计算效率的同时，减少了后验采样噪声与隐私噪声之间的直接相互作用。我们在CIFAR-10数据集上，在一系列隐私预算设置下，将DP-IVON-Gradsq与标准隐私优化器DP-SGD和DP-Adam进行了评估。
tldr: 提出差分隐私优化器DP-IVON-Gradsq，通过噪声校正的平方梯度估计器从私有化梯度构建曲率估计，在保持IVON计算效率的同时减少了后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的相互干扰，实现了差分隐私下的变分贝叶斯深度学习。
en_tdlr: DP-IVON-Gradsq is a differentially private variant of the IVON optimizer that constructs curvature estimates from privatized gradients via a noise-corrected squared-gradient estimator, reducing the interaction between posterior-sampling noise and privacy noise while preserving Adam-like computational efficiency.
